description: Change the attributes of logical volume(s)

option.name: --activate
tip: Change the active state of LVs.

option.name: --activationmode
tip: Determines if LV activation is allowed when PVs are missing, e.g. because of a device failure.

option.name: --addtag
tip: Adds a tag to a PV, VG or LV.

option.name: --alloc
tip: Determines the allocation policy when a command needs to allocate Physical Extents (PEs) from the VG.

option.name: --autobackup
tip: Specifies if metadata should be backed up automatically after a change.

option.name: --cachemode
tip: Specifies when writes to a cache LV should be considered complete.

option.name: --cachepolicy
tip: Specifies the cache policy for a cache LV.

option.name: --cachesettings
tip: Specifies tunable kernel options for dm-cache or dm-writecache LVs.

option.name: --commandprofile
tip: The command profile to use for command configuration.

option.name: --compression
tip: Controls whether compression is enabled or disable for VDO volume.

option.name: --config
tip: Config settings for the command.

option.name: --contiguous
tip: Sets or resets the contiguous allocation policy for LVs.

option.name: --debug
tip: Set debug level.

option.name: --deduplication
tip: Controls whether deduplication is enabled or disable for VDO volume.

option.name: --deltag
tip: Deletes a tag from a PV, VG or LV.

option.name: --detachprofile
tip: Detaches a metadata profile from a VG or LV.

option.name: --devices
tip: Restricts the devices that are visible and accessible to the command.

option.name: --devicesfile
tip: A file listing devices that LVM should use.

option.name: --discards
tip: Specifies how the device-mapper thin pool layer in the kernel should handle discards.

option.name: --driverloaded
tip: If set to no, the command will not attempt to use device-mapper.

option.name: --errorwhenfull
tip: Specifies thin pool behavior when data space is exhausted.

option.name: --force
tip: Override various checks, confirmations and protections.

option.name: --help
tip: Display help text.

option.name: --ignoreactivationskip
tip: Ignore the "activation skip" LV flag during activation to allow LVs with the flag set to be activated.

option.name: --ignorelockingfailure
tip: Allows a command to continue with read-only metadata operations after locking failures.

option.name: --ignoremonitoring
tip: Do not interact with dmeventd unless --monitor is specified.

option.name: --integritysettings
tip: Specifies tunable kernel options for dm-integrity.

option.name: --journal
tip: Record information in the systemd journal.

option.name: --lockopt
tip: Used to pass options for special cases to lvmlockd.

option.name: --longhelp
tip: Display long help text.

option.name: --major
tip: Sets the major number of an LV block device.

option.name: --maxrecoveryrate
tip: Sets the maximum recovery rate for a RAID LV.

option.name: --metadataprofile
tip: The metadata profile to use for command configuration.

option.name: --minor
tip: Sets the minor number of an LV block device.

option.name: --minrecoveryrate
tip: Sets the minimum recovery rate for a RAID LV.

option.name: --monitor
tip: Start (yes) or stop (no) monitoring an LV with dmeventd.

option.name: --nohints
tip: Do not use the hints file to locate devices for PVs.

option.name: --nolocking
tip: Disable locking.

option.name: --noudevsync
tip: Disables udev synchronization.

option.name: --partial
tip: Commands will do their best to activate LVs with missing PV extents.

option.name: --permission
tip: Set access permission to read only r or read and write rw.

option.name: --persistent
tip: When yes, makes the specified minor number persistent.

option.name: --poll
tip: When yes, start the background transformation of an LV.

option.name: --profile
tip: An alias for --commandprofile or --metadataprofile, depending on the command.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Suppress output and log messages.

option.name: --raidmaxrecoveryrate
tip: Sets the maximum recovery rate for a RAID LV.

option.name: --raidminrecoveryrate
tip: Sets the minimum recovery rate for a RAID LV.

option.name: --raidsyncaction
tip: Initiate different types of RAID synchronization.

option.name: --raidwritebehind
tip: The maximum number of outstanding writes that are allowed to devices in a RAID1 LV that is marked write-mostly.

option.name: --raidwritemostly
tip: Mark a device in a RAID1 LV as write-mostly.

option.name: --readahead
tip: Sets read ahead sector count of an LV.

option.name: --readonly
tip: Prevent the command from making changes, including activation and metadata updates.

option.name: --rebuild
tip: Selects a PV to rebuild in a raid LV.

option.name: --refresh
tip: If the LV is active, reload its metadata.

option.name: --reportformat
tip: Overrides current output format for reports which is defined globally by the report/output_format setting in lvm.conf(5).

option.name: --resync
tip: Initiates mirror synchronization.

option.name: --select
tip: Select objects for processing and reporting based on specified criteria.

option.name: --setactivationskip
tip: Persistently sets (yes) or clears (no) the "activation skip" flag on an LV.

option.name: --setautoactivation
tip: Set the autoactivation property on a VG or LV.

option.name: --syncaction
tip: Initiate different types of RAID synchronization.

option.name: --sysinit
tip: Indicates that vgchange/lvchange is being invoked from early system initialisation scripts (e.g. rc.sysinit or an initrd), before writable filesystems are available.

option.name: --test
tip: Run in test mode.

option.name: --vdosettings
tip: Specifies tunable VDO options for VDO LVs.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Set verbose level.

option.name: --version
tip: Display version information.

option.name: --writebehind
tip: The maximum number of outstanding writes that are allowed to devices in a RAID1 LV that is marked write-mostly.

option.name: --writemostly
tip: Mark a device in a RAID1 LV as write-mostly.

option.name: --yes
tip: Do not prompt for confirmation interactively but always assume the answer yes.

option.name: --zero
tip: Set zeroing mode for thin pool.
